title: Document strict and tolerant modes in TestWorkspaceCleanup ownership summary
outcome: Document strict and tolerant modes in TestWorkspaceCleanup ownership summary
acceptance: The TestWorkspaceCleanup class summary accurately distinguishes best-effort cleanup from decisive strict deletion and states when each is appropriate.

completion.summary: Updated TestWorkspaceCleanup's class ownership summary to distinguish decisive one-pass cleanup for Phoenix-owned index artifacts from tolerant best-effort cleanup for repositories, worktrees, and source roots.
